limitations: Built-in terraform_data state and local provisioners; no physical cloud resource identity or provider API behavior was tested.
Local-exec is used only to inject a deterministic failure and observe scratch side effects, not recommended as the default provisioning mechanism.
Saved-plan rejection after state serial change was tested; drift outside Terraform without a state update was not tested.
Same-state move and source-side forget were tested; cross-state destination import and distributed locking were not.
Official HTTPS archive SHA-256 was checked against the official HTTPS checksum file; release signature was not independently checked.
Saved plans and state are synthetic scratch artifacts; production plan or state content was not accessed.
No binary or raw plan/state artifact is included in the repository. Exact configuration, commands, observed results and output hashes are recorded here.
No state-file backup was restored; recovery used the surviving state and reviewed a new plan.

sources.scope: Stable release discovery; 1.16.4 selected rather than 1.17 prereleases
Partial apply recovery and saved plan behavior
Detailed exit code and plan artifacts
Source inspection only: saved plan state serial and lineage validation; not a runtime cloud-drift experiment
